_comment: Shared blocks for data/api/ event files. Nothing here applies unless a file or row names the block in "use". sharedSources: the events whose recordings give the shared response parts (expected/_shared/), before any other event's

trade-response-parts._comment: Every trade API returns the trade's basic and instrument parts: TestDataTool compact keeps each once per product in expected/_shared/<file> and writes references to them (the keys that differ stay in the case's file). sharedFragments here: part name -> its file. Name the block in "use" of every event whose response holds the parts, and give their paths there: "sharedFragments": { "basic": "data.trade.basic" } (data.basic in an event without trade). The rules are written against the part ({basic}.dealDate) and take its path; a case with "sharedFragments": null (or the part null) has neither the part nor its rules
